# Pinned part and Encyclopedia acquisition goals

Both JSON files are copied unchanged from Tinkers' Construct
`f4e77d43f39ba1047bf93ae816b7e1beaab514c2`:

https://github.com/SlimeKnights/TinkersConstruct/tree/f4e77d43f39ba1047bf93ae816b7e1beaab514c2/src/generated/resources/data/tconstruct/advancements

The manifest records source paths and SHA-256 hashes. Native adaptations
change the legacy part inventory tag predicate and icon item keys. The
Make Part icon's wood-material NBT is omitted because native advancement
icons accept an item ID only; acquisition criteria are not weakened.
